verdict.rationale: Bento documents broadcasts as one-time marketing sends to a broad audience or saved segment. Its API can create campaigns and schedule sends with explicit audience rules, including tag exclusions, and segments and drag-and-drop templates support targeting and composition; the CLI and MCP can also create broadcasts. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the in-app compose-and-send-now flow for broadcasts (the drag-and-drop editor is documented on the sequences page), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the campaign send loop.
